article.headline: ‘Man on the Inside’ to End With Season 3 at Netflix
article.summary: “A Man on the Inside” will end with Season 3 at Netflix, which is now in production. The critically-acclaimed comedy was renewed for a third season back in March, with Season 2 having debuted in January.
